name: MakeWay
summary: Canadian charity whose shared platform takes in community-led environmental and social initiatives. Not taking new projects for now.

evidence.quote: first and largest of its kind in Canada
MakeWay Charitable Society (BN 130560188 RR0001) is a registered operating charity and shared platform.

projects.value: Community-led initiatives where nature and communities thrive together

evidence.quote: We are always seeking new initiatives* that align with our vision of a world where nature and communities thrive together
By joining the shared platform, projects become part of MakeWay Charitable Society.
MakeWay allocates 10-12% of project revenues to contribute to shared overhead costs.

min_income.value: An annual budget of more than $100,000 is a good fit

evidence.quote: Projects with an annual budget of more than $100,000 are a good fit for the shared platform model.

value.note: payroll and benefits run by MakeWay

evidence.quote: employee onboarding payroll administration group benefits and administration

value.note: Not taking new projects or inquiries during a strategic planning process.

evidence.quote: The Shared Platform is currently pausing intake of new projects while we undertake a strategic planning process. During this time, we are not taking new inquiries
